name: Denalan's Earth
summary: In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf sends a late shipment of rare earth south to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth. The night elf researcher studies Teldrassil's young plants.

sections.title: A Courier for Dolanaar
sections.body: Syral Bladeleaf stops travelers in Dolanaar with a special shipment of rare earth for Denalan. The soil came from Darnassus to support his botanical studies, but delays kept it from reaching Dolanaar until now. Syral seeks a courier to carry the parcel south along the forest trail to Denalan's campsite by Lake Al'Ameth.

sections.title: Cultivating Teldrassil
sections.body: Denalan works alone at a station on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore, watching Teldrassil's young ecosystem take root. The tree grew quickly after the Battle of Mount Hyjal, and its plants behave in unexpected ways. Denalan tests the vitality and behavior of timberlings and native plants with unique soil mixtures and specimens. The rare earth shipment will support those experiments.

faq.answer: Denalan is a night elf researcher and herbalist who camps on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore. He studies, cultivates, and experiments on Teldrassil's distinctive plant life.
Syral Bladeleaf is in Dolanaar, the main night elf outpost in central Teldrassil. She coordinates research supplies and helps travelers crossing the boughs.

faq.q: What is the rare earth used for?
aliases: what does denalan need the earth for
faq.answer: The shipment is specially enriched soil from Darnassus. Denalan uses it to nurture experimental plantings and test how native saplings, including timberlings, respond to different growing conditions.

aliases: how to get to lake al'ameth
faq.answer: Lake Al'Ameth lies south of Dolanaar among Teldrassil's southern roots.
The package traveled from Darnassus and faced unspecified delays on Teldrassil's winding roads before reaching Dolanaar.

faq.q: What does delivering this earth lead to?
faq.answer: After receiving the rare soil, Denalan asks the courier to gather timberling sprouts and seeds along the lake shore, opening a wider study of the plants there.

angles.text: If you practice herbalism, Denalan's lakeside retreat may interest you. His experiments seek to understand the fragile plant life unique to the newly grown World Tree.
As a druid, you share an affinity with Denalan's work. Following Teldrassil's plant growth and balance helps protect nature on the new bough.
As a night elf from Shadowglen, helping Syral and Denalan introduces you to the wider care needed to sustain Teldrassil.
